workarounds.title: Composer aliases for broken 2.4.4 package constraints
workarounds.detail: Magento 2.4.4 does not resolve as shipped. Require magento/security-package:1.1.3-p1 as 1.1.3 and magento/inventory-metapackage:1.2.4-p1 as 1.2.4 before composer install.

workarounds.title: Elasticsearch 8 needs magento/module-elasticsearch-8
workarounds.detail: Stock 2.4.6/2.4.7 only talk to Elasticsearch 7. Add "replace": {"magento/module-elasticsearch-7": "*"} to composer.json and composer require magento/module-elasticsearch-8. The public mirrors carry builds that resolve on 2.4.6-p10+ and 2.4.7-p5+; earlier patch releases need the build from repo.magento.com.

workarounds.title: Alias the Elasticsearch 8 client for older patch releases
workarounds.detail: Core on 2.4.6-p9 and earlier and 2.4.7-p4 and earlier pins elasticsearch/elasticsearch to ~8.5, below the ^8.15 that the mirrored magento/module-elasticsearch-8 needs. composer require "elasticsearch/elasticsearch:8.17.1 as 8.5.3" satisfies both.

workarounds.detail: Adobe quality patch for 2.4.4 patch releases running on PHP 8.3.

workarounds.title: ACSD-46815: static content deploy fails with the compact strategy

workarounds.title: Elasticsearch XSD rejected by libxml2 2.12+
workarounds.detail: Fixes "complex type 'mixedDataType': The content model is not deterministic" when a product is saved or the search index rebuilt. Needed wherever PHP links libxml2 2.12 or newer. Patch by Pieter Hoste, shipped upstream in 2.4.8 and Mage-OS 1.1.0.

workarounds.title: GLOB_BRACE is undefined on Alpine/musl PHP
workarounds.detail: MvcApplication globs with GLOB_BRACE, which musl PHP below 8.5 does not define. Backports the Mage-OS 3.5.0 Filesystem\Glob fix. Not needed on glibc-based PHP.

workarounds.title: GLOB_BRACE is undefined on Alpine/musl PHP
workarounds.detail: Same GLOB_BRACE fix as Magento 2.4.9. Mage-OS 3.2 and later install on musl without it. Not needed on glibc-based PHP.

workarounds.title: Typed class constants break PHP 8.2 in the reservations grid module
workarounds.detail: mage-os/module-inventory-reservations-grid 1.0.1 (pinned by Mage-OS 2.0.0) declares `const string` / `const array`, which is PHP 8.3 syntax, so setup:install fails on PHP 8.2 with "syntax error, unexpected identifier TABLE_NAME". Upstream fixed it in 0e32434 (PHP <8.3 compat, #14); Mage-OS 2.1.0 ships the fixed module.

workarounds.title: PHP 8.4 implicit-nullable deprecation stops setup:di:compile
workarounds.detail: Magento\\AdminAnalytics\\Model\\Condition\\CanViewNotification::__construct() declares `ScopeConfigInterface $scopeConfig = null`. PHP 8.4 deprecates the implicit nullable and Magento's error handler turns the deprecation into an exception. The fix adds `?`. Merged to release/1.x in mage-os/mageos-magento2#158 after 1.3.1 was tagged, so no 1.x release carries it; 2.0.0 does.
